name: Constellation Space
long_description:
Constellation Space is building the critical software infrastructure for orbital resilience.

Fleets are scaling from hundreds of satellites to tens of thousands, but operations still run on static margins and reactive fixes. Data dies in orbit every day to weather, congestion, and interference nobody saw coming.

ConstellationOS forecasts link conditions ahead of every pass, so operators recover far more of the downlink they already paid for, with no changes to existing mission control.

Built by former SpaceX, Blue Origin, and NASA engineers. Backed by Y Combinator (W26). platform.constellation.space | hello@constellation.space
one_liner: Physics-grounded autonomy for satellite link forecasts and fleet ops.
